name: Belnap semiprime unfolding

phase_0.boundary_condition: The odd integer N and its bit-length define the closed boundary of the unfolding search space.

⊢.justification: The state before any factor bits are determined; the register holds no information about the decomposition of N.

⊣.justification: The fixed target value that bounds the search; the system cannot exceed the bit-length of N without violating the product constraint.

≻.justification: The forward morphism that advances the search from bit k to k+1, propagating the convolution sum forward.

≺.justification: The reverse morphism that resolves the carry from the current bit position back into the constraints of the previous positions.

⋈.justification: The sequential composition of bit-determination steps, linking the state at k to the state at k+1.

⊙.justification: The identity state where the recovered factors multiply exactly to N, confirming the system's internal consistency.

∈.justification: Splits the search space into branches based on which subset of factors introduces a new 1-bit at the current position k.

∋.justification: Rejoins the branches by resolving the carry equation, fusing conflicting bit-assignments into a single valid state or a contradiction.

⊤.justification: The affirmative arm where the partial product matches the target bits and the carry equation holds.

⊥.justification: The negative arm where the bit-sum violates the parity or magnitude constraints of N.

⊞.justification: The state where a carry value is simultaneously required to be 0 and 1 to satisfy different factor constraints, held as a live contradiction.

⊡.justification: The permanent record of the recovered factors once the product equals N, written to the output log.

phase_2.split_input: partial factor bits at position k
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: No bits determined; the search space is the full set of possible factor combinations.
phase_3.true_description: A valid partial factor tuple exists that matches N up to bit k with a consistent carry.
phase_3.false_description: No valid partial factor tuple exists; the current branch violates the convolution constraints.
phase_3.both_description: A state where the carry equation is satisfied by conflicting bit-assignments, holding both possibilities simultaneously.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the search with an empty set of factor bits and zero carry.
Anchor the system to the target integer N and its bit-length.
Chain the initial state to the first bit position k=0.
Branch on the possible assignments of 1-bits at position k for the factors.
Advance the morphism to compute the convolution sum for the current bit.
Evaluate the affirmative arm where the sum matches the target bit of N.
Reverse the morphism to propagate the carry back to the previous state.
Evaluate the negative arm where the sum violates the target bit or carry constraints.
Fuse the branches by resolving the carry equation into a single state.
Chain the resolved state to the next bit position k+1.
Branch again on new 1-bit assignments for the next position.
Advance the morphism to compute the next convolution sum.
Hold the state where conflicting carry requirements create a dialetheic condition.
Evaluate the affirmative arm where the contradiction resolves to a valid carry.
Evaluate the negative arm where the contradiction leads to a dead branch.
Fuse the branches to determine the final carry state for this position.
Chain the state forward until all bits of N are processed.
Self-reference the state where the product of factors equals N exactly.
Fix the final factor tuple as a permanent record of the unfolding.
Close the system by confirming the boundary condition of N is satisfied.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The bit-convolution algorithm that translates the integer N into a sequence of bit-constraints.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The carry-propagation mechanism that communicates state between bit positions.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The state vector holding the partial factor bits and the current carry value.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The bit-position loop that determines the order of constraint evaluation.
phase_5.alfs_store: The reference implementation of the unfold function in umnifold.py.

phase_6.cycle_cost: One bit of information per position processed, plus the branching factor for carry resolution.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A set of possible factor tuples with undefined bits beyond position k.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A reduced set of factor tuples with bits determined up to position k+1.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The unfolding process is entropy-conservative because it merely reorganizes the information in N into its factors without creating or destroying information.
